h1: Anatomy of a Moonrock at Cape Cod Cannabis in Wellfleet, MA

blocks.text: Anatomy of a Moonrock at Cape Cod Cannabis in Wellfleet, MA
Cannabis moonrocks are a premium product in the cannabis industry, known for their high potency and unique composition.

blocks.html: A cannabis moonrock is typically made by coating cannabis flower with cannabis concentrate and then covering it in kief. The result combines three cannabis components — flower, concentrate and kief — into one infused flower product.

blocks.text: Hover over HOTSPOTS (+) for more information.

items.label: Flower
items.tipHtml: Flower (also known as bud) is the smokable part of a Cannabis plant. Similar to plants like Willow and Kiwi, Cannabis plants are either male or female. The female Cannabis plant is the only one that produces the flowers, while the male plants produce the pollen necessary to create seeds.

items.label: Concentrate
items.tipHtml: A viscous, golden liquid created by refining cannabis resin. Distillation allows the processor to isolate a desired compound from the cannabis plant and leave behind undesirable plant material. Distillates are commonly used in vape cartridges and can also be used in edibles, topicals, and other products.

items.label: Kief
items.tipHtml: Kief, sometimes transliterated as keef, also known as "Dust" and "Chief" a.k.a cannabis crystals among other names, refers to the pure and clean collection of loose cannabis trichomes, which are accumulated by being sifted from cannabis flowers or buds with a mesh screen or sieve.

blocks.titleAttr: Cape Cod Cannabis Recreational Dispensary in Wellfleet, MA

blocks.html:
Cannabis moonrocks are a combination of several cannabis products, creating a potent and flavorful experience. They typically consist of:

1. Flower: High-quality cannabis buds form the core of moonrocks. The flower is usually chosen for its high THC content and aromatic profile.

2. Concentrate: The cannabis buds are dipped or coated in hash oil or another type of cannabis concentrate. This sticky layer adds an extra layer of potency. *Distillate may be used as the concentrate in some products.

2b. Cannabis concentrate is a broad category of concentrated cannabis extracts. Distillate is a highly refined type of cannabis extract produced through additional processing intended to concentrate particular cannabinoids. Depending on the formulation, terpenes or other ingredients may also be present.

3. Kief: After being coated in concentrate, the buds are rolled in kief. Kief is the collection of trichomes, or the resin glands of the cannabis plant, which contain high concentrations of cannabinoids and terpenes. The kief coating gives moonrocks their signature frosty appearance.

– Potency: Because moonrocks combine flower with concentrated cannabis extracts and kief, they can contain substantially higher cannabinoid concentrations than conventional cannabis flower. Potency varies by product, so consumers should review the product label and testing information before use.

– Flavor and Aroma: The use of high-quality cannabis flower and concentrates means that moonrocks often have a rich and complex flavor and aroma profile. The terpenes from the flower and concentrate, along with the kief, contribute to a multi-layered sensory experience.

– Appearance: Moonrocks are visually distinctive, often appearing as lumpy, dense nuggets with a sticky, oily exterior and a powdery coating of kief. They have a frosted look due to the kief.

– Consumption Method: Moonrocks are best consumed using a glass pipe or bong due to their sticky and dense nature. Breaking them down with a grinder is not recommended as it can cause loss of kief and concentrate. Instead, they should be broken apart by hand.

– Why are Moonrocks considered high-potency Cannabis? Because moonrocks combine cannabis flower, concentrate and kief, they can contain higher concentrations of cannabinoids than traditional flower. Individual experiences vary based on the specific product, cannabinoid and terpene profile, amount consumed and individual tolerance.

– Price: Due to the high-quality ingredients and the intensive production process, moonrocks tend to be more expensive than regular cannabis flower.

– Dosage: Because of their high potency, users should start with a small amount to gauge their tolerance and avoid consuming too much at once.

Cannabis moonrocks are a premium, high-potency product made by coating cannabis buds in distillate (or concentrate) and rolling them in kief. They offer a unique and intense experience, characterized by strong effects and rich flavors.

Because moonrocks may contain higher concentrations of THC than conventional flower, adults who are unfamiliar with high-potency cannabis should review the product label carefully, begin conservatively and ask a knowledgeable budtender if they have questions about the product.

A cannabis moonrock is an infused cannabis product typically made from three components: cannabis flower, cannabis concentrate and kief. The flower is coated with concentrate and covered in kief, creating a product that can contain higher concentrations of cannabinoids than traditional flower.
Cannabis Flower + Concentrate + Kief. *Distillate is sometime used instead of concentrate.

Kief is the collection of tiny, resinous trichomes that naturally form on cannabis flower. These trichomes contain cannabinoids and terpenes and can separate from the plant material during handling or processing. In a cannabis moonrock, kief is typically used as the outer coating, sticking to the layer of cannabis concentrate surrounding the flower.

items.q: How are cannabis moonrocks typically consumed?

blocks.html: Cannabis moonrocks are typically broken into small pieces by hand and consumed using a pipe, bowl or similar smoking device. Because moonrocks are dense and coated with cannabis concentrate and kief, they can be sticky and difficult to grind. Consumers should review the product label and potency information before use and start with a small amount, especially if they are unfamiliar with high potency cannabis products.
